name: Conguillío: Sierra Nevada trail
why: Up an araucaria ridge from Lago Conguillío to a lookout under the glaciers of Sierra Nevada, with Llaima volcano reflected in the lake below.
book: Park ticket in advance at pasesparques.cl. The trail starts at Playa Linda at the east end of Lago Conguillío; gravel roads inside the park.
water: Little water on the ridge: carry 2 litres.
dangers: Steep, loose volcanic ground in the upper part.
Avalanches and falling trees in July and August; snow until November.
turnaround: Not at the Sierra Nevada lookout by 13:30: turn back at Mirador Los Cóndores.

points.name: Playa Linda, Lago Conguillío
points.note: The trailhead by the beach at the east end of the lake. The path climbs at once into the araucarias.

points.name: Mirador Los Cóndores
points.note: The first lookout over Lago Conguillío and Llaima volcano, about an hour up.

points.name: Mirador Sierra Nevada
points.note: The end of the trail at about 1,700 m, under the glaciers of Sierra Nevada. Return the same way.
